info.name: SWARNA Gold Loan API (CodeIgniter 3 port)
info.description: Covers every /api/v1 endpoint ported to codeigniter3-app. Set {{base_url}} (default http://localhost:8080) and run 'Auth > Login' first — its Tests script saves the returned token into {{token}}, used as the Bearer token for every other request via the collection-level auth.
